segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including a teenager and adults who say most acne washes are too harsh for them, consistently report no irritation, redness, or tightness.
segments.oily: Oily, breakout-prone reviewers report it cleans effectively without the stripped, tight, squeaky feeling other acne washes leave, though one notes it can start to dehydrate her skin if left on too long.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with oily or breakout-prone skin, report it doesn't leave skin dry or stripped despite the salicylic acid, though one reviewer notes it can dehydrate her skin a little if left on longer than a quick wash.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report no irritation, stinging, or redness, including on sensitive skin and directly on active breakouts.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who worried salicylic acid would damage her skin barrier, as it has for her in the past, reports she had no such issue with this cleanser.
concerns.blemishes: This is the concern reviewers report on most consistently and positively, including several managing cystic acne linked to PCOS: reviewers describe fewer breakouts, calmer flare-ups, and clearer skin with regular use, and no reviewer in this set reports it causing new breakouts.

extraits.titre: Did not irritate my sons sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I picked up this face wash for my teenage son who’s just starting to deal with some mild acne, and it’s been a great addition to his routine so far. He has pretty sensitive skin, so I’m always cautious about trying new products, but this one hasn’t caused any irritation or redness. It does a nice job of keeping his skin clear without over-drying, which is a big plus. The 2% salicylic acid seems to help with small breakouts and clogged pores, and I like that it also has ingredients to keep the skin balanced and hydrated. He also uses a PanOxyl bar, and we find curology a bit more hydrating,… this cleanser works really well as part of his rotation. He follows it up with a moisturizer, and together it’s been a simple, effective routine. Overall, a solid option for teens with sensitive, acne-prone skin.

extraits.titre: gentle yet effective cleanser for oily skin that is truly unscented
extraits.texte: After trying another curology facial cleanser that was too gentle for my oily skin, I was excited to see how this performed. From the first use I was impressed by the effectiveness of this wash, without the stripping that is often accompanied with the use of acids. I cannot leave this on my skin too long, or it does start to dehydrate a little, but it's been a solid cleanser and has not caused any adverse reactions. 5 oz for 16 wasn't a bad deal for a cleanser that stands up to the test of an oily complexion. This leaves my skin feeling soft and helps to keep it more clear of breakouts, which I've always been prone to. No fragrance is solid for those with sensitivities to such additives.

I’m prone to cystic acne (thanks to PCOS) and I’ve been using this product for over a month. And let me tell you, this is the only cleanser that doesn’t leave my skin super dry, and keeps my acne away! I wash my face once a day, and at night. The product itself is a thick gel texture, however when you squeeze it on your hands and add some water it becomes the perfect consistency. I also love how it leaves my skin feeling moisturized and love how it doesn’t have a funky smell!

Curology 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash for Acne Prone Skin I liked this a lot. It helped calm down a breakout quickly. I was worried it would be drying because salicylic acid can sometimes wreck my skin barrier, but I didn’t have that issue here. The texture is thicker and creamier than most acne washes, which I actually preferred. The tube is also pretty large at 5 oz. At $16, I think this is very reasonably priced. I would absolutely buy this again.

Acne cleansers are generally too harsh on my sensitive skin. This cleanser did not bother my sensitive skin👍🏻 I use Curology’s gentle cleanser on a regular basis so I figured I would try this one. I was not disappointed. There is no fragrance, which is definitely a plus for me. It is a light gel consistency. It makes my skin feel clean without being dry or tight. It is gentle enough for my super sensitive skin. The price is a bit high, but everything is overpriced these days. The cleanser helps with keeping my skin clear so I would say it is effective. I would recommend this cleanser.

My skin is oily and breakout-prone and a lot of acne washes leave it tight and squeaky. This one cleans without that stripped feeling, which I think is the niacinamide and glycerin doing their thing. No fragrance, no sting around active spots, and my skin feels moisturized. I use it morning and night and a small amount goes a long way, so the tube lasts. Not an overnight fix, but after a few weeks my skin feels calmer. I think it's pretty effective, it's a good value, and I'm glad I switched.
I randomly decided to switch to Curology and I love it. I get cystic acne and my flare ups have been reduced dramatically.

reserve: Only 16 reviews are available for a product with 76 total, so this reading is directional rather than exhaustive, though the accounts present are detailed and consistent.
